name: Aizawa Nagisa
source:
A waitress at the Forest Side cafe. She's extremely shy and struggles with interacting with people.

She's trying to improve her personality by working part-time at the cafe, but her clumsy side makes it difficult for her to succeed.

Though introverted, her actions are surprisingly bold—almost as if she's an outgoing girl. When the protagonist treats her kindly, she goes beyond the cafe's standard service...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
